links.description: Links about the track elsewhere: Discogs, Bandcamp, the artist's site…

duration.description: Media duration in seconds, when known.

description.description: Free text. #tags and @mentions are parsed from it.

playbackError.description: Set by the radio's owner when the media could not be played, as provider:code, e.g. youtube:150 for a video that can't be embedded.

main.description: A media reference curated into a radio: a URL with a title, a description and #tags.
